title: Benchmark consultation on FOB S. America lithium carbonate prices
gist: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence has opened a public consultation to move its FOB South America lithium carbonate assessment to weekly publication (Wednesdays, 4 p.m. London), restrict it to spot transactions on a standardised 60-day delivery window, lift the grade spec from min 99.0% to battery grade min 99.5%, and broaden the loading basis from Antofagasta alone to include Buenos Aires. It is a short methodology notice, but it re-cuts a benchmark that index-linked lithium contracts reference, and its stated rationale is growing South American production and export volumes. Feedback closes 7 September 2026.

insights.claim: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence has proposed increasing the frequency of its FOB South America lithium carbonate price assessment to weekly, published on Wednesdays by 4 p.m. London time.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A higher-frequency published lithium reference shortens the lag in index-linked contract settlement and gives traders a faster mark for South American carbonate exposure.

insights.claim: Benchmark proposes to restrict its weekly FOB South America lithium carbonate assessment to spot transactions only, on a standardised 60-day delivery window.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Stripping term and long-dated volumes out of the assessment makes the printed price a purer, and likely more volatile, spot signal — a different series to the one existing contracts were struck against.
insights.quote: Benchmark proposes to include only spot transactions, with a standardised 60-day delivery window, in the weekly assessment.

insights.claim: The methodology changes to the FOB South America lithium carbonate assessment were prompted by feedback and discussion with market participants rather than being imposed unilaterally by the price reporting agency.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Participant-driven demand for a weekly spot print signals that South American cargo trade is now liquid enough to support one — an indirect read on market depth.
insights.quote: Following feedback and discussion with a number of market participants

themes.theme: Grade spec lifted to battery grade 99.5%

insights.claim: Benchmark proposes to redefine the FOB South America lithium carbonate grade as battery grade at minimum 99.5% purity, replacing the currently collected minimum 99.0% specification.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: The assessed series shifts from a purity band that could include technical-grade material to a strictly battery-grade one, so any level change in the print after the switch is a specification effect, not a market move.
insights.quote: Lithium Carbonate; Min 99.0%; FOB South America; USD/Tonne

themes.theme: Argentina added to the loading basis

insights.claim: Benchmark proposes to broaden the origin basis of its FOB South America lithium carbonate assessment to cargoes loaded at both Antofagasta, Chile and Buenos Aires, Argentina, rather than Antofagasta alone.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Argentine export flows are now being treated as price-setting alongside Chilean ones — a structural marker that Argentina has moved from marginal producer to a component of the regional benchmark.
insights.quote: to better capture the full range of South American export flows

insights.claim: Benchmark's stated rationale for reworking the assessment is that South American lithium production and export volumes continue to grow, requiring the price assessment to be re-cut to stay reflective of trading conditions.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A price reporting agency widening ports and raising frequency is a supply-growth tell: the region's export volume is outrunning the granularity of the existing benchmark.
insights.quote: As South American lithium production and export volumes continue to grow, Benchmark continues to monitor and evolve its price assessments to ensure they remain reflective of prevailing market and trading conditions.

insights.claim: Benchmark's public consultation on the FOB South America lithium carbonate methodology closes to market-participant feedback on 7 September 2026, with comments taken at prices@benchmarkminerals.com.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Anyone with contracts referencing the existing min 99.0% Antofagasta-only series has a fixed window to object before the reference they settle against is redefined.
insights.locator: Benchmark invites feedback from active market participants
